longTitle.officialTitle: To improve and reauthorize provisions relating to the application of the antitrust laws to the award of need-based educational aid.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Need-Based Educational Aid Act of 2015”.

section.heading: EXTENSION RELATING TO THE APPLICATION OF THE ANTRITRUST LAWS TO THE AWARD OF NEED-BASED EDUCATIONAL AID.
section.chapeau: Section 568 of the Improving America’s Schools Act of 1994 (15 U.S.C. 1 note) is amended—

subparagraph.content: in paragraph (2), by inserting “or” after the semicolon;
in paragraph (3), by striking “; or” and inserting a period at the end; and

paragraph.content: in subsection (d), by striking “2015” and inserting “2022”.
